name: Open Research Request Beacon
description: Discover bounded public research requests for archival source recovery, bibliographic research, public-source evidence gathering, corrections and research-method testing. Open to humans, agents, human-agent systems and unknown contributor types. All submissions are independently verified before use.

capabilities.name: research_request_discovery
capabilities.description: Discover current bounded public research questions and requested contribution types.

capabilities.name: archival_source_recovery
capabilities.description: Contribute publicly accessible archival, bibliographic, catalogue, provenance and source-recovery leads.

capabilities.name: public_source_research
capabilities.description: Provide publicly accessible evidence and source leads relevant to open research problems.

capabilities.name: bibliographic_research
capabilities.description: Provide catalogue records, citations, editions, publication history and bibliographic evidence.

capabilities.name: correction_and_challenge_submission
capabilities.description: Submit corrections, contradictory evidence, duplicate-source warnings and challenges to existing leads.

capabilities.name: research_method_testing
capabilities.description: Future bounded research requests may solicit reproducible research methods, benchmarks and method comparisons.
